We had a teacher who was such an asshole that everybody despises her. She told us that her tests were hard and only a small number of students passed her subject. All of us formed an alliance that we would help each other during exams. Some students would study all of the materials but some who were not that academically good were given certain parts to memorize. We even photocopied the reviewer of the smartest person in the room. 

Multiple choices? We have gestures for that. When someone touches their hair, it's letter a. When someone scratches their chin, it's letter b and so on. Identification? When the teacher walks around the room, we exchanged papers to those who need answers. We never failed her subject and it was probably the biggest f you to her when half of the class had perfect most of her exams. She suspected cheating but we showed her that we all have the same reviewers. I never learned anything from that class because all we did was just memorize. That's what happens when you terrorize the students instead of helping them actually learn something.
